facts.value: USB 3.0 via a USB type C connector

setup.en: Install Ultraleap Hand Tracking (Gemini 5.x) and plug the sensor in; "/Applications/Ultraleap Hand Tracking.app/Contents/bin/leapctl" devices should list it with Tracking: true.
setup.zh: 安裝 Ultraleap Hand Tracking（Gemini 5.x），插上感測器。執行 "/Applications/Ultraleap Hand Tracking.app/Contents/bin/leapctl" devices 應該會列出它，並顯示 Tracking: true。

setup.en: Install the Xcode command line tools (clang): the bridge compiles its small C reader on first start.
setup.zh: 安裝 Xcode 命令列工具（clang）：橋接程式第一次啟動時會編譯它的 C 讀取程式。

setup.en: Run the bridge, node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs, and check http://127.0.0.1:6437/health; install.sh keeps it running at login.
setup.zh: 執行橋接程式 node packages/leap/bridge/leap-bridge.mjs，再看 http://127.0.0.1:6437/health。install.sh 會讓它在登入時自動執行。

problems.en: A page on a public https site that reaches the bridge on this machine meets Chrome's local network prompt; blocked, it fails with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_LOCAL_NETWORK_ACCESS_CHECKS. Allow it, or open the page from localhost.
problems.zh: 公開 https 網站上的網頁連到這台電腦的橋接程式時，Chrome 會跳出區域網路的詢問。被封鎖時會出現 net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_LOCAL_NETWORK_ACCESS_CHECKS。請允許，或改從 localhost 開網頁。

use.en: Through the local bridge, both hands become leap/hand/<side>/… signals (palm position, pinch, grab, angles, fingertips), and leap.hands has the joints for drawing.
use.zh: 經過本機的橋接程式，兩隻手變成 leap/hand/<side>/… 訊號（手掌位置、捏合、抓握、角度、指尖），leap.hands 有畫手用的關節。

tbd.en: This is the Controller 2, the sensor @openav/leap's gesture thresholds were tuned on. The first Leap Motion Controller is another unit with other numbers, not described here.
tbd.zh: 這是 Controller 2，@openav/leap 的手勢門檻就是在它上面調的。第一代 Leap Motion Controller 是另一台，數字不同，這裡沒有描述。

tbd.en: Frame rate, power, size and the preferred tracking range were not on a manufacturer page that could be read.
tbd.zh: 畫面更新率、耗電、尺寸和建議的追蹤距離，沒有在讀得到的原廠頁面上找到。
